name: YouTube Media & Bilingual Subtitles
author: OmniDesk
description: YouTube subscriptions, search, channels, playlists, yt-dlp stream resolution, SponsorBlock chapter merge, and bilingual subtitle pre-translation.

config_schema.label: YouTube Data API Key（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional YouTube Data API v3 key stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault.

config_schema.label: YouTube OAuth Token（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional OAuth 2.0 Bearer token for subscriptions, stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault.

config_schema.label: yt-dlp 可执行路径
config_schema.description: Executable name on PATH or explicit path to yt-dlp.

config_schema.label: 地区代码
config_schema.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code for YouTube API and feeds (e.g. US, JP, TW).

config_schema.label: 首选画质上限
config_schema.description: Preferred stream quality ceiling when resolving yt-dlp formats.

config_schema.label: 字幕缓存目录（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional directory for cached bilingual subtitles; defaults to plugin data/cache directory.

config_schema.label: 关注频道 ID 列表（可选）
config_schema.description: Comma-separated YouTube channel IDs or @handles used when OAuth is not configured.

config_schema.label: 播放列表 ID 列表（可选）
config_schema.description: Comma-separated YouTube playlist IDs (e.g. WL, PL...) for playlists and watch later.

config_schema.label: 双语字幕目标语言
config_schema.description: Target translation language passed to llm.translate.v1.

config_schema.label: 网络与工具超时（秒）
config_schema.description: Timeout in seconds for YouTube Data API, subtitle downloads, and yt-dlp calls.

config_schema.label: 已有 Netscape Cookie 文件（v1 兼容）
